# THE ORGANIC CLUB

> English publication about Account-Generated Distribution (AGD), initiated by TokPortal. AI-assisted editorial analysis with source links and explicit evidence limits.

## About this publication
- [Editorial policy](https://theorganiclub.com/en/about/): affiliation, AI assistance, sources and corrections.
- [AGD lexicon](https://theorganiclub.com/en/lexicon/): proposed framework terms, not scientific consensus.
- [The Lab](https://theorganiclub.com/en/lab/): protocols are proposals unless results are explicitly documented.
- [Article index](https://theorganiclub.com/en/library/)
- [Sitemap index](https://theorganiclub.com/sitemap.xml)
- [RSS](https://theorganiclub.com/feed-en.xml)

## Articles
- [What Is AGD Marketing? Account-Generated Distribution Explained](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/distribution-is-the-moat/): Account-Generated Distribution (AGD) organizes differentiated social accounts as organic distribution infrastructure. More accounts only make strategic sense when audiences, voices and creative work also differ.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/distribution-is-the-moat/article.md)
- [AI Content for Social Media: How to Avoid Generic Output](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/ai-sameness/): AI Slop describes output that puts volume ahead of distinctiveness and usefulness. It is an editorial judgment about the result, not an automatic diagnosis based on which tool made it.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/ai-sameness/article.md)
- [Account Isolation in AGD: Build Distinct Social Accounts](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/account-isolation/): Account Isolation is the AGD principle that gives every account a sufficiently distinct identity, audience and purpose to operate as an independent editorial surface.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/account-isolation/article.md)
- [Native Posting vs API Posting on TikTok: What Can You Test?](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/native-vs-api/): Comparing Native Posting with API publishing requires comparable cohorts and identical observation windows. This note reports no experimental result: the verdict remains unknown.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/native-vs-api/article.md)
- [TokPortal MCP Tutorial: Preview an AI Workflow with Dry Run](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/machines/agent-first-dry-run/): TokPortal MCP exposes social operations to an agent. A preview uses top-level dry_run: true, with creation parameters inside body; the decision to execute live remains a separate step.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/machines/agent-first-dry-run/article.md)
- [AGD for TikTok 101: Accounts, Content and Your First Tests](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/multi-account-strategy/): A Multi-Account Strategy distributes a brand’s experiments across differentiated accounts. It is AGD’s organizational foundation, not its complete definition.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/multi-account-strategy/article.md)
- [Content Isolation: How to Differentiate a Multi-Account Strategy](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/content-isolation/): Content Isolation preserves meaningful creative differences between accounts: narrative, angle, format or purpose. It complements Account Isolation, which differentiates distribution surfaces.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/content-isolation/article.md)
- [Social Media Content Saturation: What It Means for AGD](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/content-saturation/): Content Saturation describes content supply exceeding available attention. Within AGD it is a thesis about competition, not an established universal measurement.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/content-saturation/article.md)
- [How AGD Changes the Competition for Organic Reach](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/feed-escalation/): Feed Escalation is our editorial term for intensifying formats, output and optimization inside feeds. It is not a scientific metric.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/feed-escalation/article.md)
- [Organic Social Media for Apps: A StudyFetch TikTok Breakdown](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/attention-war/): For an app, a useful AGD creative connects a recognisable audience problem to a visible product action. In this StudyFetch post, the creator introduces a specific memorisation task, shows the corresponding prompt on a laptop and exposes the generated answer. The connection is the lesson to study.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/attention-war/article.md)
- [AGD vs Phone Farms: Strategy, Accounts and Infrastructure](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/agd-not-phone-farm/): Phone Farming describes infrastructure for operating accounts across mobile environments. AGD describes a distribution model: the two categories are not synonyms.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/agd-not-phone-farm/article.md)
- [How to Build an AGD Strategy with Your Existing Tools](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/agd-without-tokportal/): AGD is a strategy framework. TokPortal provides infrastructure that can support execution. A category that only works with one brand mostly looks like a campaign.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/agd-without-tokportal/article.md)
- [AGD Marketing Principles: A Practical Editorial Framework](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/ten-principles/): AGD principles combine differentiated accounts, creative diversity, contextual execution and measurable learning. They form a decision framework, not an algorithmic recipe.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/ten-principles/article.md)
- [AGD Marketing Mistakes: Volume, Copying and False Promises](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/anti-principles/): AGD anti-principles challenge clones, volume without diversity, certainty without data and averages without context. These are editorial and operational choices.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/anti-principles/article.md)
- [What Is a Native TikTok Account? Context and Limitations](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/native-account/): In the AGD lexicon, a Native Account is created and maintained in the real consumer application environment. The definition describes execution.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/doctrine/native-account/article.md)
- [How to Build a Social Media Persona: The Duolingo Example](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/account-persona/): An Account Persona is the recurring identity that gives an account a perspective: who speaks, to whom, and why people return.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/account-persona/article.md)
- [TikTok Hook Examples: Replace Clickbait with a Clear Payoff](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/hook-slop/): Hook Slop means intense but interchangeable openings disconnected from the content’s actual value. It is an editorial criticism, not a platform category.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/hook-slop/article.md)
- [Faceless TikTok Marketing: A Finch App Video Breakdown](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/faceless-account/): A faceless TikTok creative needs a visible subject and a repeatable way to explain it. Finch’s seasonal-challenge post uses a character, familiar actions and completion cards to make a feature concrete. The example is branded animation, with an inspectable relationship between the scene and the product.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/faceless-account/article.md)
- [TikTok Content Series: Build a Repeatable Format](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/formatted-account/): A Formatted Account uses a repeatable creative structure an audience can recognize. Repetition concerns the promise, not necessarily the substance.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/formatted-account/article.md)
- [Duolingo’s TikTok Strategy: Character, Chaos and Continuity](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/chaotic-account/): A Chaotic Account allows several formats rather than one rigid template. In AGD, chaotic means flexible, not devoid of audience or logic.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/chaotic-account/article.md)
- [AI Personas for Social Media: Character Design and Disclosure](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/ai-persona/): An AI Persona substantially uses AI for appearance, voice or production. Its editorial value still depends on coherence and usefulness.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/ai-persona/article.md)
- [Persona-Based AGD: Give Each Account a Distinct Voice](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/persona-agd/): Persona AGD organizes a network around distinct editorial characters rather than generic brand accounts.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/persona-agd/article.md)
- [TikTok Slideshow Strategy: Story Structure for AGD](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/slideshow-agd/): Slideshow AGD uses accounts publishing native carousels or slideshows. A useful sequence progresses, giving a clear reason to reach the next screen.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/slideshow-agd/article.md)
- [How to Structure a TikTok Slideshow as a Story](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/story-slideshow/): A Story Slideshow organizes a sequence around a situation and its resolution. Its value is narrative; it does not depend on a magic slide count.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/story-slideshow/article.md)
- [Educational TikTok Content: Turn a Real Process into a Story](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/educational-slideshow/): An educational slideshow communicates usable knowledge during reading. Its entire promise should not be deferred to a sales page.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/educational-slideshow/article.md)
- [Brand Memes on TikTok: What Ryanair’s Persona Can Teach You](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/meme-slideshow/): A Meme Slideshow builds its sequence around a cultural observation or punchline. A product can fit inside it, but cannot replace the comic mechanism.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/meme-slideshow/article.md)
- [TikTok Product Discovery: Lessons from the Ocean Spray Video](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/product-discovery/): Product discovery content introduces a tool inside an understandable use case. An editorial approach does not remove the need to disclose a relevant commercial relationship.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/product-discovery/article.md)
- [Brainrot Marketing: When Internet Culture Helps a Brand](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/brainrotization/): Brainrotization is our cultural shorthand for fast, absurd and compressed feed formats. It describes neither a medical condition nor a cognitive measurement.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/brainrotization/article.md)
- [How to Write a TikTok Creative Brief with a Concrete Example](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/creative-brief/): An AGD creative brief connects audience, promise, format and hypothesis. It gives a creator direction and an analyst an interpretable question.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/creative-brief/article.md)
- [TikTok Hooks and Payoffs: A Zach King Video Breakdown](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/hook-payoff/): The payoff is the narrative or practical answer to the opening promise. Its alignment with the hook is checked in the content, not only in a retention curve.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/hook-payoff/article.md)
- [How to Build a TikTok Creative Library from Real Examples](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/creative-library/): A creative library organizes concepts, versions, rights and results. It lets a team recover an idea and its test conditions without relying on memory.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/creative-library/article.md)
- [TikTok Content Fatigue: When to Refresh a Recurring Format](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/format-fatigue/): Format fatigue is a hypothesis about weakening response after repetition. Studying it requires separating repetition from weaker topics and audience changes.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/format-fatigue/article.md)
- [Creative Testing Matrix: Lessons from LEGO’s Instagram Reel](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/creative-matrix/): A creative matrix crosses variation dimensions: audience, problem, angle and format. It helps select experiments rather than mechanically filling every cell.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/creative/creative-matrix/article.md)
- [TikTok Account Warming: Define a Relevant, Testable Routine](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/field-notes/niche-warming/): Niche Warming means exploring niche content in the app through searches, viewing and authentic interactions. Its precise effect on reach remains a testable hypothesis.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/field-notes/niche-warming/article.md)
- [Native TikTok Posting: Workflow, Features and Quality Checks](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/field-notes/native-posting/): Native Posting means publishing through a platform’s consumer interface. An API may orchestrate work without being the final publishing channel.

- [Native Account Warming: Actions, Records and Limits](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/field-notes/native-warming/): Native Warming happens in the real application through ordinary, authentic interactions. The practice should remain meaningful to the person performing it.

- [US TikTok Accounts: Geography, Setup and Audience Limits](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/field-notes/geo-targeted-account/): A Geo-Targeted Account is established and operated in its target market. Geography is one execution context among others, without guaranteeing audience composition.

- [Geo-Posting for TikTok: Location Context vs Audience Targeting](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/field-notes/geo-posting/): Geo-Posting means publishing through an account operated in the target market. Content must still fit that audience’s uses, references and constraints.

- [TikTok Content Localization: Go Beyond Translation](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/field-notes/localization-not-translation/): Localization adapts meaning, references and uses. A grammatically correct translation can preserve a scenario irrelevant to its new audience.

- [Social Publishing Handoffs: What to Give Your Operator](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/field-notes/operator-handoff/): A handoff transfers an executable task with assets, constraints and success conditions. Ambiguity should be resolved before irreversible action.

- [TikTok Publishing Schedule: Plan Windows, Not Magic Minutes](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/field-notes/publishing-window/): A publishing window defines an acceptable interval for a task. It supports planning without claiming a particular minute guarantees better reach.

- [Why Does My TikTok Have Zero Views? A Diagnostic Workflow](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/field-notes/zero-views/): Stuck at 0 views describes low or absent distribution after publication. Without further evidence it identifies neither enforcement nor its cause.

- [TikTok Shadowban or Low Reach? How to Investigate](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/field-notes/shadowban/): Shadowban is an informal term for suspected distribution suppression without explicit notice. Here it remains a hypothesis unless evidence establishes it.

- [TikTok Publishing Failures: Separate Upload, Access and Reach](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/field-notes/distribution-failure/): A distribution failure can involve account access, a feature, removed content, a missing publication or weak reach. These states call for different responses.

- [Organic Brand Accounts: Native Content and Transparent Identity](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/field-notes/native-not-deceptive/): Content can be useful, native and commercial at once. Editorial product integration should not invent independence or experience that does not exist.

- [Reddit Marketing and AGD: Contribute Before You Promote](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/field-notes/reddit-agd/): Reddit AGD adapts account differentiation to legitimate community participation. It does not mean multiplying identical promotional posts.

- [Community Marketing: How Brands Join Existing Conversations](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/field-notes/community-distribution/): A community is not merely an acquisition channel. Community distribution depends on contributions matching its expectations and rules.

- [Social Media Content Rights: A Publishing Checklist](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/field-notes/content-rights/): A provenance register connects images, sounds and videos to their origins and checked usage conditions. It provides an operational basis for publishing with known rights.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/field-notes/content-rights/article.md)

- [How to Budget an AGD Experiment: Costs and Learning Goals](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/field-notes/budget-of-learning/): A learning budget includes production, coordination, execution and analysis. It helps select interpretable experiments beyond publishing cost alone.

- [What Counts as a Viral TikTok? Define the Comparison](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/viral-hit/): A Viral Hit is an unusually high distribution outcome relative to a defined baseline: account, cohort or campaign. A fixed view threshold does not fit every context.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/viral-hit/article.md)
- [TikTok Viral Hit Rate: Define Attempts and Measure Outcomes](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/viral-hit-rate/): Viral Hit Rate is the proportion of eligible posts exceeding a predefined outlier threshold. Interpretation depends on threshold, cohort and window.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/viral-hit-rate/article.md)
- [TikTok Analytics: Average vs Median Views Explained](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/median-vs-mean/): The mean adds values and divides by their count. The median describes the middle of a sorted series. They answer different questions.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/median-vs-mean/article.md)
- [Social Media Analytics: How to Read Performance Percentiles](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/percentiles/): A percentile locates a value in an ordered distribution. P90 describes its upper region but depends on cohort size and definition.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/percentiles/article.md)
- [Why a Few TikTok Posts Can Dominate Your Reach](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/power-law/): Concentration measures the share of outcomes produced by a fraction of posts. An unequal distribution is not automatically evidence of a power law.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/power-law/article.md)
- [Multi-Account Analytics: Measure Performance Concentration](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/top-ten-accounts/): Account concentration shows which assets carry the total outcome. It complements post-level analysis by revealing structural dependence.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/top-ten-accounts/article.md)
- [How to Compare TikTok Campaigns with Matched Cohorts](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/matched-cohorts/): A matched cohort aligns observations on known characteristics. It reduces some visible differences without automatically eliminating all confounding.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/matched-cohorts/article.md)
- [Best Time to Post on TikTok? Test Timing Without the Myths](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/posting-time-myth/): Posting-time effects may depend on audience and context. A universally optimal time is not demonstrated in this protocol.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/posting-time-myth/article.md)
- [How Often Should You Post on TikTok? Design a Useful Test](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/posting-frequency/): A frequency test must separate total volume, per-post performance and production load. Higher totals can coexist with weaker individual posts.

- [Does TikTok Account Warming Work? An Experiment Protocol](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/warming-study/): A warming protocol compares preparations defined before publishing. It should separate niche learning, account behavior and later outcomes.

- [Does TikTok Account Age Affect Reach? What to Compare](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/account-age/): Account age can be associated with history, followers and behavior. Comparing old and new accounts requires distinguishing those dimensions.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/account-age/article.md)
- [TikTok Slideshows vs Videos: How to Compare the Formats](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/slideshow-vs-video/): Comparing slideshow and video requires a comparable promise and audience. Reading behavior and available metrics may differ between formats.

- [TikTok Content Strategy: Recurring Series vs Spontaneous Posts](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/formatted-vs-chaotic/): A Formatted versus Chaotic test compares a recurring structure with multiple formats. It needs a shared editorial objective and documented variation.

- [TikTok Creative Testing: Compare Ideas, Not Just Edits](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/creative-diversity-test/): A creative-diversity test examines meaningful variation rather than counting files. It connects concepts with outcomes and their stability.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/creative-diversity-test/article.md)
- [TikTok Native Features: Test Their Creative Contribution](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/native-features-test/): A native-feature test separates a feature’s effect from its publishing channel. Comparing whole workflows does not always allow that separation.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/native-features-test/article.md)
- [How to Measure Your TikTok Zero-View Rate](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/zero-view-rate/): Zero-view rate depends on observation age, measurement source and eligibility scope. Missing data must remain separate.

- [Social Media Experiments: Confidence Intervals Explained](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/confidence-intervals/): An interval expresses uncertainty under a method’s assumptions. It does not fix a poor sample, incomplete measurement or confounding.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/confidence-intervals/article.md)
- [TikTok Case Studies and Survivorship Bias: What Is Missing?](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/survivorship-bias/): Survivorship bias appears when analysis retains only still-visible units. A network evaluated without abandoned accounts can look artificially strong.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/survivorship-bias/article.md)
- [Why TikTok Views Drop After a Viral Post](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/regression-to-mean/): An extreme outcome can be followed by more ordinary outcomes. This possibility cautions against attributing every decline to the latest decision.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/regression-to-mean/article.md)
- [Campaign Cohort Analysis: Compare Equally Mature Results](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/cohort-maturity/): Day-seven conversion should cover people given seven full days to convert. Mixing mature and recent cohorts distorts comparisons.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/cohort-maturity/article.md)
- [TikTok Marketing Attribution: UTMs, Visits and First Purchases](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/attribution/): Campaign parameters describe an instrumented origin. They do not alone prove a piece of content caused a purchase decision.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/attribution/article.md)
- [From TikTok Views to Sales: Measure the Customer Journey](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/views-to-buyers/): Views measure exposure under the platform’s definition. New buyers measure a separate commercial outcome requiring its own definition and source.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/views-to-buyers/article.md)
- [Social Media Experiment Template: Write the Plan First](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/experiment-preregistration/): Preregistering means recording an experiment’s question, criteria and planned analysis in advance. It limits stories reconstructed after observation.
  [Plain-text edition](https://theorganiclub.com/en/read/lab/experiment-preregistration/article.md)

## Evidence and citation
Use the canonical article URL when citing. Preserve qualifications, source dates and the distinction between observation and interpretation. The markdown edition contains the same editorial material and its source links. Native posting, geographic execution and this publication do not guarantee reach, sales or search visibility.
